steps.en: Install the deja binary with its installer or package manager
steps.zh: 用安装脚本或包管理器装上 deja 二进制

steps.en: Let it wire every coding agent it finds and build the first index
steps.zh: 一条命令接进它发现的所有 agent，并建好首个索引

steps.en: Parses every transcript already on disk into one local index, stripping credentials as it goes
steps.zh: 把磁盘上已有的所有会话记录解析成一份本地索引，随手剥离凭据

steps.en: Work as usual; when an old decision comes up, open a session or search from the terminal
steps.zh: 照常干活；想起旧决定时开新会话或在终端直接搜

steps.en: Answers with the matching sessions — the decision, the files it touched, whether things changed since
steps.zh: 送回命中的会话：当时的决定、动过的文件、此后有无变化

value.en: Months of history — including agents you no longer use — answers from the day you install it
value.zh: 装上第一天起，几个月的历史——连不再用的 agent 也算——就能替你回答

sources: README Install (curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh; brew install deja-vu; deja install --auto wires MCP recall into every agent it finds, turns on session-start recall, builds the first index)
README Highlights (Starts full: deja "connection pool exhausted" over pre-install history on day one)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (source parsers read JSONL and SQLite stores via external sqlite3; records.bin + buckets + manifest.gob; per-file incremental ingest)
README Privacy (credentials are stripped as the index is built; sources untouched)
README MCP tools (one `deja` tool with modes recall/context/blame/fix/how/orient/remember)
